correctness.rationale: From x*x=0 one obtains x_(i+2)^2=-x_i^2, enforcing period four of coordinate squares. This proves vanishing in odd characteristic unless four divides n, a reduced line/plane in characteristic two, and independent parity root-lines when four divides n in odd characteristic. The root choices give exactly 2^(n-2) geometric planes, the finite-field counts follow from whether -1 is a square, and explicit extension counts yield the rational zeta functions. A standard-library program directly verifies 38 finite cases and rational zeta coefficients; the all-parameter theorem rests on the proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Nilpotency of the entire algebra is not square-zero of an individual element. value.rationale: The absolute-nilpotent fiber of a graph evolution algebra is a natural nonassociative-algebra invariant. For the complete family of undirected cycles, the result combines all geometric component counts with every finite-field extension count and explicit rational Hasse–Weil zeta function, exhibiting a characteristic and quadratic-residue splitting that cannot be inferred from mere geometric existence. This motivated exact classification is substantive without asserting a broader graph theorem.
